local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
function dragify(Frame)
	dragToggle = nil
	dragSpeed = 0.15
	dragInput = nil
	dragStart = nil
	dragPos = nil
	function updateInput(input)
		Delta = input.Position - dragStart
		Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + Delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + Delta.Y)
		game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(Frame, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {Position = Position}):Play()
	end
	Frame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) and UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() == nil then
			dragToggle = true
			dragStart = input.Position
			startPos = Frame.Position
			input.Changed:Connect(function()
				if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
					dragToggle = false
				end
			end)
		end
	end)
	Frame.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragInput = input
		end
	end)
	game:GetService("UserInputService").InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if input == dragInput and dragToggle then
			updateInput(input)
		end
	end)
end
dragify(mainbg)

-- Product info cache for listener lookups
local productInfoCache = {}

local function getProductName(productId)
    if productInfoCache[productId] then
        return productInfoCache[productId]
    end
    
    local success, productInfo = pcall(function()
        return MarketplaceService:GetProductInfo(productId, Enum.InfoType.Product)
    end)
    
    if success and productInfo then
        productInfoCache[productId] = productInfo.Name
        return productInfo.Name
    end
    
    return "Unknown Product"
end

GetProductsBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    -- Clear existing entries (keep the button)
    for _, child in pairs(scannerTabFrame:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("Frame") and child.Name == "ProductEntry" then
            child:Destroy()
        end
    end
    
    local success, developerProducts = pcall(function()
        return MarketplaceService:GetDeveloperProductsAsync()
    end)
    
    if success and developerProducts then
        local currentPage = developerProducts:GetCurrentPage()
        
        while true do
            for _, product in pairs(currentPage) do
                createScannerProductEntry(product.Name or "Unknown", product.ProductId or product.Id or 0, product.PriceInRobux or 0)
            end
            
            if developerProducts.IsFinished then
                break
            end
            
            local nextSuccess = pcall(function()
                developerProducts:AdvanceToNextPageAsync()
            end)
            
            if not nextSuccess then
                break
            end
            
            currentPage = developerProducts:GetCurrentPage()
        end
        
        print("Loaded all developer products")
    else
        warn("Failed to get developer products:", developerProducts)
        
        -- Fallback: show error message in scanner
        local ErrorLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        ErrorLabel.TextWrapped = true
        ErrorLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 53, 53)
